notes.title: Update 0.1.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
🛠 Update 0.1.6 Patch Notes – Cargo Shop Simulator
🎧 Sound & Ambience
City ambience sounds have been added.

Vehicle engine sounds are now in the game.

All ambient sounds can now be toggled on/off via the settings menu.

Mouse sensitivity setting has been added.

🖱 Controls & Interface
A new mouse system has been implemented for the PC and POS devices. Interactions are now much easier.

🌆 Gameplay & Exploration
You can now climb buildings (but not stand on top).

A hidden surprise awaits if you find the portal... Don’t miss it!

notes.title: Early Access 0.1.15 Patch
notes.notes:
🚀 Cargo Shop Simulator – Early Access Update 0.1.5
Hello cargo lovers!
With the Early Access 0.1.5 update, we've introduced several important improvements, bug fixes, and gameplay adjustments. Based on your valuable feedback, we're continuing to refine the core flow of the game to make it smoother and more intuitive. Here's what's new in this version:

🎮 Gameplay & Controls

The crate control system has been simplified. Instead of using E+R and E+F combinations, you can now control crate directions directly with just R and F keys.

Input fields now support the Enter key for navigation, in addition to the Tab key.

The price under the POS machine is now visually animated to make it more readable.

The credit card payment system has been visually and functionally improved.

🛠️ General Fixes & Improvements

Conveyor belt position has been adjusted, and an issue causing overcharging or undercharging has been fixed.

A fix has been implemented for the NaN Dollar issue that occurred after incorrect or incomplete deliveries.

The unnecessary "coffee pastry" sign has been removed from the scene.

🔊 Audio & Feedback

The character now has new footstep and landing sounds after walking, running, or jumping.

📚 Tutorial & User Experience

The tutorial section has been made more understandable. Early game confusion has been reduced with a clearer flow and improved guidance.

notes.title: Early Access 0.0.9 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
🛠️ Cargo Shop Simulator - Early Access 0.0.9 Patch Notes
Hey cargo managers! 👋
We're continuing to improve the game based on your valuable feedback throughout Early Access. With the 0.0.9 update, we've fixed several bugs and made some improvements:

🔧 Bug Fixes:
💳 Fixed an issue where the credit card could get stuck in the POS device during payment.

💬 Resolved a bug where the speech bubble remained on screen even after the customer left.

🤖 Fixed inconsistent movement behavior of the PC assistant robot.

📦 Addressed a bug where the carrier robot could get stuck in certain areas.

🚪 Adjusted tight areas near door entrances and removed invisible collision zones.

🎵 Improvements:
📏 Package measurement points are now more visible and easier to identify.

🎶 Background music has been updated. Music now continues smoothly across day transitions.

Your feedback is always welcome and appreciated!
Thanks for playing and keep on shipping! 💼📦

notes.title: Early Access 0.0.8 Patch
notes.notes:
🚚 Early Access 0.0.8 Patch Notes
Hey Cargo Masters! 📦
Update 0.0.8 is here, bringing smoother gameplay, clearer instructions, and hopefully—fewer rage-inducing moments 😄 Here's what's new and improved in this version:

🔧 Fixes & Improvements
🔄 You can now press ESC to return to the menu. Simple and effective.

🖱️ Dual monitor cursor bug has been fixed. Your mouse is no longer making a break for the second screen!

🚧 Invisible barriers have been removed. No more ghost walls getting in your way.

⚖️ Box weighing in Normal Mode is now faster. Customers will get angry a little slower now... maybe.

🖨️ Improved outline visuals on the printer. Cleaner, smoother lines.

🎓 An explanatory tutorial has been added for new players. You won’t feel lost anymore—we’ve got your back.

🕺 Character movement is now more realistic. Less robot, more human.

🧊 Fixed a bug where boxes could get stuck inside the scale. Boxes are now free to go!

🚪 Added outline shader to vehicle doors. More visible, more stylish.

🤖 Fixed purchase bugs with the conveyor and delivery robot. Your money won't vanish into thin air anymore.
